title.narrative: Desk Review of Denmark's support to Women Deliver

description.narrative: The review is foreseen to be a desk review lead by the Department for Evaluation, Learning and Quality (ELK) assisted by an external consultant. The purpose of the desk review is to assist ELK/MFA in conducting the review by providing input to an impartial assessment of the progress of the Danish support to WD (2021-23). The overall objective of the desk review is to assess the performance of Women Deliver in delivering results under its strategic objectives and engagement with the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs (from 2021-23), with a particular view on the effectiveness and efficiency of the management in pursuing the identified development outcomes and observe cost effectiveness. The recommendation of the desk review will provide critical input to the MFA’s on-going dialogue with WD.
